امتلكتم (form VIII)
# اِمْتَلَكْتُمْ (imtalaktum) /im.ta.lak.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# اُمْتُلِكْتُمْ (umtuliktum) /um.tu.lik.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
